title: News report: survivors of the plane crash at Jamaica Hospital

tellings.quote: they have received here at Jamaica Hospital, they've received 14 survivors from the plane crash.

plain: An unnamed news reporter, standing at Jamaica Hospital in New York, says the hospital has "received 14 survivors from the plane crash." The clip is played in an episode with the writer Jason Jorjani, and the reporter is describing what the hospital itself has said.
